title: Ceiling on the Charge This Charter Fixes for an Auto Loans Late Charge
content:
The ceiling that holds down the charge this charter fixes for a late charge on a loan of the Auto Loans line is read from how many late charges have been assessed on that loan in the last twenty-four months.

| Late charges assessed on the loan in the last twenty-four months | Ceiling |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 25.00 |
| At least 2 but fewer than 3 | 22.00 |
| Fewer than 2 | 15.40 |

The ceiling is 25.00 where 3 or more late charges have been assessed on the loan in the last twenty-four months. It is 22.00 where at least 2 but fewer than 3 late charges have been assessed on the loan in that window. It is 15.40 where fewer than 2 late charges have been assessed on the loan in that window.

## What is counted

The count is of late charges assessed on that one loan, in the twenty-four months ending on the day the correction is made. Charges of other kinds on the same loan are not counted, and late charges on another of the borrower's Auto Loans are not counted.

## The count read at each step

A loan carrying 2 late charges assessed inside the window sits on the middle row, since 2 is at least 2 and fewer than 3, and takes a ceiling of 22.00.

A loan carrying 3 late charges assessed inside the window sits on the top row and takes a ceiling of 25.00.

A loan carrying 1 late charge, or none at all, inside the window sits on the bottom row and takes a ceiling of 15.40.

A loan carrying 4 late charges of which 2 fall outside the twenty-four months counts only the 2 inside it, and therefore takes 22.00.
